23
Chlorine displaces bromine from aqueous potassium bromide.
The ionic equation for the reaction is shown.
Cl 2+2Br–→2Cl–+Br2
Which statement about this reaction is correct?
A
Bromide ions act as an oxidising agent.
B
Bromide ions are oxidised as electrons are lost.
C
Chlorine acts as a reducing agent.
D
Chlorine is reduced as electrons are lost.

options.label: A
options.text: Bromide ions act as an oxidising agent.

options.label: B
options.text: Bromide ions are oxidised as electrons are lost.
